summary.name: Rows
summary.one_liner: Rows is an AI-powered spreadsheet and data analysis tool that lets you import data from documents and business tools and analyze it using plain language.
use_cases: Extract tables from PDFs into a spreadsheet
Build live reports from business data
Create embeddable pricing calculators or charts
Analyze team data without writing formulas or SQL
Import web tables into a spreadsheet
summary.what_it_does: Rows lets users import data from PDFs, databases, analytics tools, bank accounts, and websites, and then analyze it by describing what they want in plain language. The AI can build live reports, dynamic models, and calculators that behave like a spreadsheet. The RowsX browser extension imports tables from websites in one click. Reports and interactive dashboards can be shared and embedded elsewhere, such as in a Notion doc or on a website, with data kept up to date. The product also supports real-time collaboration within teams.
notable: Plain-language AI analysis with no SQL, code, or formulas needed
RowsX extension imports tables from thousands of websites in one click
Embeddable live reports and calculators that stay in sync with data
Connects to 50+ sources including PDFs, databases, analytics tools, and bank accounts
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the directory listing marks it as free, but paid limits are not stated
